data_fields.name: stinger_length_ms
data_fields.donor_constant: computed from the asset at load (no literal)

best_idea: Take a cue's length from the asset itself, once at load, by integrating its tempo map, so a stinger or bed hand-off uses the true length for any tempo change rather than a typed-in number.
decision_why: Load-time length from the file fits a client-only cue system: the server sends a cue id and the client reads the length. Keep milliseconds for the client and ticks only for scripts, and widen the jingle field so a long cue is not wrapped (D1).
acceptance: A stinger's length is read from its file at boot, not typed in; a headless test loads a two-track MIDI with a tempo change halfway and asserts the length equals the hand-computed value within 1 ms; a 70-second cue is sent with its real length, not wrapped.
